detail.longDescription:
Wow, even credit card companies are worried about AI bots. #agenticAI #creditcards

I got an email today which said:

"To help protect your accounts, do not share sensitive information with an AI tool:

•	Keep your log-in information private, like username, password, and verification codes.
•	Avoid entering account numbers, card information, or CVV/security codes.
•	Do not upload documents with financial details, including bank statements or tax forms."

This means some people are already doing some or all of the above.
